title: Best Mashed Potatoes
nutrition_tip: Make the best mashed potatoes with this easy recipe — just potatoes, warm milk,…

ingredients.name: 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and quartered
3 cloves garlic, peeled, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and garlic, lower heat to medium, and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
When the potatoes are almost finished, heat milk and butter in a small saucepan over low heat until butter is melted.
Drain potatoes and return to the pot. Slowly add warm milk mixture, blending it in with a potato masher or electric mixer until potatoes are smooth and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with extra butter and enjoy!
